events.prompt: A photograph of a quiet hot-spring town lane at blue hour in gentle snowfall, seen at eye level from across the lane, with natural perspective. Top of the picture: snow-laden wooden eaves and a strip of deep-blue evening sky. Middle: the lane recedes to the left between old dark-timber inns with closed wooden lattice doors; a few small plain paper lanterns glow under the eaves, getting smaller into the distance. Bottom third: smooth fresh snow covering the lane, untouched in the foreground. A 24-year-old adult Korean woman with honey-orange brown hair in a layered wolf cut, wearing a long deep-cranberry wool coat over an ivory knit mini dress and white knee-high boots, walks slowly from right to left along the lane with her hands in her coat pockets, glancing up at the falling snow, her face in three-quarter view. She is a modest figure a little right of centre, with the lane opening out ahead of her; her whole body is visible, both boots stand on the snow, and a wide stretch of snow lies between her boots and the bottom of the picture. The nearest lantern casts a warm amber pool of light on her and on the snow around her; everything else stays cool blue. It is a quiet pedestrian lane: plain timber walls, lattice doors, lanterns and snow are all there is.
